functions.name: tgit_sum
functions.signature: extern "C" int tgit_sum(int a, int b);
functions.description: Computes and returns the sum of two int arguments using C linkage (extern "C"). Intended for simple integer addition and interop across C and C++ (C ABI). Typical usage: pass two int values and receive their sum as an int. No error reporting is specified; callers should ensure the result fits in int to avoid undefined behavior due to signed overflow.
requirements: Both a and b must be representable as int on the target platform.
The computed sum a + b must be within the range of int to avoid signed overflow (undefined behavior in C/C++).
No prior initialization or specific call ordering is required; the function is pure with respect to program state.
